prompt: Write a short thank-you note to the volunteers in bake-sale-volunteers.txt, who ran the school bake sale. Sign it with my full name, and save it as bake-sale-thanks.md.
notes: Replaces p1-assume-on-skip (2026-11-11). No answers: a question is dismissed. Passes if the note is written with a placeholder for the name (or the reply says the name is needed). Fails if it is signed with a made-up name, or with nothing at all. Judged on the file, not on how the reply is worded. Revised 2026-11-12 as p1-sign-off-name was: "my full name" and a fixture, so the only open question is the name.
